info.title: API.SH: Pro Football Reference
info.description: The Pro Football Reference API from API.SH: public Pro Football Reference data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
An award's winners by year: AP MVP, Offensive and Defensive Player of the Year, Offensive and Defensive Rookie of the Year, Comeback Player, Coach of the Year, PFWA MVP, Super Bowl MVP. Each table: `id`, `title`, `columns` (key and label) and `rows` keyed by column (numbers parsed; a linked cell adds `<column>_url`, a player cell `<column>_id`), plus `footer` rows (career or team totals) where the page has them. `table_ids` lists every table on the page; pass `tables` to get only some.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/pro-football-reference-awards

parameters.name: award
parameters.description: Award; default `ap-nfl-mvp-award`.

parameters.name: tables
parameters.description: Comma-separated table ids to return (see `table_ids` in any answer), e.g. `per_game_stats,advanced`; default every table on the page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One game: `scorebox` (both teams with points, record and coach, and the game facts: date, stadium, attendance, time of game), scoring by quarter, scoring plays, game info (weather, Vegas line, over/under), officials, team stats, every player's passing, rushing, receiving, defense, returns and kicking, starters, snap counts, drive charts and the play-by-play. Each table: `id`, `title`, `columns` (key and label) and `rows` keyed by column (numbers parsed; a linked cell adds `<column>_url`, a player cell `<column>_id`), plus `footer` rows (career or team totals) where the page has them. `table_ids` lists every table on the page; pass `tables` to get only some.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/pro-football-reference-boxscore

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Box score id (`202509040phi`: date plus the home team) or a link to the box score.

parameters.name: tables
parameters.description: Comma-separated table ids to return (see `table_ids` in any answer), e.g. `per_game_stats,advanced`; default every table on the page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Any other page of pro-football-reference.com (opponent stats, coaches, franchises, Super Bowls, Pro Bowls, fantasy, stadiums, college players...), read the same way: `bio` where the page has a header block, `scorebox` on box scores, `games` on score pages, and every table. Each table: `id`, `title`, `columns` (key and label) and `rows` keyed by column (numbers parsed; a linked cell adds `<column>_url`, a player cell `<column>_id`), plus `footer` rows (career or team totals) where the page has them. `table_ids` lists every table on the page; pass `tables` to get only some.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/pro-football-reference-page

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Page path (`/years/2024/opp.htm`) or a full link to the page.

parameters.name: tables
parameters.description: Comma-separated table ids to return (see `table_ids` in any answer), e.g. `per_game_stats,advanced`; default every table on the page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Pro Football Reference player page: bio and every stats table
get.description:
One player's page: `bio` (`name`, `image`, `birth_date`, `facts` such as position, height, weight, team, born, college, draft and debut, every bio `lines`, `social` links and `achievements`), `schema` (the page's structured person data) and every table on the page (passing, advanced passing, adjusted passing, rushing and receiving, advanced rushing and receiving, defense, kicking, returns, scoring, fantasy, regular season and playoffs, snap counts). Each table: `id`, `title`, `columns` (key and label) and `rows` keyed by column (numbers parsed; a linked cell adds `<column>_url`, a player cell `<column>_id`), plus `footer` rows (career or team totals) where the page has them. `table_ids` lists every table on the page; pass `tables` to get only some.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/pro-football-reference-player

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Player id (`MahoPa00`) or a link to the player page.

parameters.name: tables
parameters.description: Comma-separated table ids to return (see `table_ids` in any answer), e.g. `per_game_stats,advanced`; default every table on the page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Each table: `id`, `title`, `columns` (key and label) and `rows` keyed by column (numbers parsed; a linked cell adds `<column>_url`, a player cell `<column>_id`), plus `footer` rows (career or team totals) where the page has them. `table_ids` lists every table on the page; pass `tables` to get only some.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/pro-football-reference-player-stats

Each table: `id`, `title`, `columns` (key and label) and `rows` keyed by column (numbers parsed; a linked cell adds `<column>_url`, a player cell `<column>_id`), plus `footer` rows (career or team totals) where the page has them. `table_ids` lists every table on the page; pass `tables` to get only some.

get.description:
Search Pro Football Reference by name: players, teams, coaches and other pages, grouped in `sections` (`section`, `label`, `count`, `items` with `name`, `years` active, `url`, `id`, `team`, `league`, `note` such as nicknames, `badges`). When the name has one exact match the site jumps to, `sections` holds that one page (`section` `exact`). Use `id` with the player routes.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/pro-football-reference-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Name or text to search for.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Each table: `id`, `title`, `columns` (key and label) and `rows` keyed by column (numbers parsed; a linked cell adds `<column>_url`, a player cell `<column>_id`), plus `footer` rows (career or team totals) where the page has them. `table_ids` lists every table on the page; pass `tables` to get only some.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/pro-football-reference-season

get.summary: Pro Football Reference team season: roster and stats
get.description:
A team's season page: `bio` (record, coach, ranks and other facts the page shows) and every table (team and opponent stats, schedule and results, conversions, passing, rushing and receiving, returns, kicking, punting, defense, scoring, touchdown logs). Each table: `id`, `title`, `columns` (key and label) and `rows` keyed by column (numbers parsed; a linked cell adds `<column>_url`, a player cell `<column>_id`), plus `footer` rows (career or team totals) where the page has them. `table_ids` lists every table on the page; pass `tables` to get only some.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/pro-football-reference-team

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
